# google_backup_dr_data_source_reference

A reference to a data source in Backup and DR.


To get more information about DataSourceReference, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/backup-disaster-recovery/docs/reference/rest)
* How-to Guides
    * [Official Documentation](https://cloud.google.com/backup-disaster-recovery/docs)

## Example Usage - Backup Dr Data Source Reference


```hcl
terraform {
  required_providers {
    google-beta = {
      source = "hashicorp/google-beta"
    }
  }
}

# NOTE: This example assumes a DataSourceReference with the specified ID
# already exists in the given project and location.

data "google_backup_dr_data_source_reference" "my_dsr" {
  provider                 = google-beta
  data_source_reference_id = "example-dsr-id"
  location                 = "us-central1"
  # project                  = "your-project-id" # Optional
}

output "dsr_data_source" {
  value = data.google_backup_dr_data_source_reference.my_dsr.data_source
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `backup_vault` -
  (Required)
  The backup vault to be referenced.

* `data_source` -
  (Required)
  The data source to be referenced.

* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location for the data source reference.

* `data_source_reference_id` -
  (Required)
  The id of the data source reference.


* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.



## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/dataSourceReferences/{{data_source_reference_id}}`

* `name` -
  The name of the data source reference resource created.

* `create_time` -
  The time when the data source reference was created.

* `update_time` -
  The time when the data source reference was updated.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 60 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 60 minutes.

## Import


DataSourceReference can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/dataSourceReferences/{{data_source_reference_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{data_source_reference_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{data_source_reference_id}}`


In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import DataSourceReference using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/dataSourceReferences/{{data_source_reference_id}}"
  to = google_backup_dr_data_source_reference.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), DataSourceReference can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_backup_dr_data_source_reference.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/dataSourceReferences/{{data_source_reference_id}}
$ terraform import google_backup_dr_data_source_reference.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{data_source_reference_id}}
$ terraform import google_backup_dr_data_source_reference.default {{location}}/{{data_source_reference_id}}
```
